arms.diagnostic_note: The speedup (49x) exceeds the theoretical estimate of ~10x from the Dedekind sum alone, indicating the additional optimizations (Kloosterman symmetry 2x, direct cos_sin_basecase, float path for prec<=53) compound significantly. discrepancy_analysis: Prediction confirmed. Direction correct (large decrease in runtime). Magnitude larger than conservatively estimated due to compounding of four synergistic optimizations. No correctness regressions detected.
